status: PARAMETERS SOURCED; MECHANICAL UK REPLAY RUN; CALIBRATION BLOCKED

incubation_early.citation: Lauer et al., Annals of Internal Medicine
incubation_early.evidence: 181 confirmed cases; median incubation 5.1 days (95% CI 4.5-5.8).

incubation_variants.citation: Wu et al., JAMA Network Open
incubation_variants.evidence: Systematic review/meta-analysis of 142 studies and 8,112 patients; Alpha 5.00, Delta 4.41, Omicron 3.42 days; substantial heterogeneity.

infectiousness_ancestral.citation: Cevik et al., The Lancet Microbe
infectiousness_ancestral.evidence: Systematic review/meta-analysis; no live virus isolated beyond day 9 and no respiratory sample after day 8 yielded live virus in reviewed studies; RNA shedding was longer.

infectiousness_omicron.citation: Wu et al., International Journal of Infectious Diseases
infectiousness_omicron.evidence: Systematic review/meta-analysis of 29 studies and 230,227 patients; pooled viable-virus shedding 5.16 days (95% CI 4.18-6.14), PCR positivity 10.82 days.

ifr_early.citation: Verity et al., The Lancet Infectious Diseases
ifr_early.evidence: Model-based early-pandemic analysis; overall China IFR 0.66% (95% CrI 0.39%-1.33%), strongly age-dependent.

incubation_period.evidence_justification: Primary early-pandemic median selected for historical 2020 calibration; not universal across 2020-2026.
incubation_period.applicability_limitations: Early symptomatic confirmed cases; may overrepresent severe cases and describes symptom onset, not necessarily latent period to infectiousness.

sigma.source: Derived from incubation_period sourced from incubation_early
sigma.evidence_justification: Exact reciprocal under the project-specified relationship.
sigma.applicability_limitations: Uses incubation as the project E-to-I proxy; incubation and latent period are not identical.

infectious_recovery_period.evidence_justification: Operational primary assumption anchored to no live respiratory virus after day 8; not PCR/RNA shedding duration.
infectious_recovery_period.applicability_limitations: Culture-positive duration is not identical to population infectiousness; evidence is heterogeneous and early-pandemic.

gamma.source: Derived from infectious_recovery_period sourced from infectiousness_ancestral
gamma.evidence_justification: Exact reciprocal under the project-specified I-to-R relationship.
gamma.applicability_limitations: Depends on an explicit operational infectious-period assumption.

mortality_transition_parameter.evidence_justification: With IFR probability p=0.0066 and competing hazards, mu = gamma*p/(1-p) = 0.125*0.0066/(1-0.0066).
mortality_transition_parameter.applicability_limitations: Early China IFR is age- and period-dependent; mapping assumes IFR deaths occur through the I-to-D hazard. OWID CFR is not used.

mortality_parameter_definition.value: mu is the per-time infectious-to-deceased transition rate in dI/dt = sigma*E - (gamma+mu)*I and dD/dt = mu*I; IFR p is the competing-hazard probability p=mu/(gamma+mu).
mortality_parameter_definition.evidence_justification: CFR, IFR, mortality probability, and mortality transition rate are explicitly distinguished; reported CFR is not copied into mu.
mortality_parameter_definition.applicability_limitations: The competing-hazard mapping is a model assumption and must be sensitivity-tested.

beta_calibration.relationship: For the implemented equations, R0(t)=beta(t)/(gamma+mu) at full susceptibility and Reff(t)=beta(t)*S(t)/[N*(gamma+mu)]. Rt_estimated is a Cori renewal-ratio effective-Rt estimate, so, conditional on using it as the model Reff, beta(t)=Rt_estimated(t)*(gamma+mu)*N/S(t) for the transition beginning at t. beta(t)=Rt_estimated(t)*(gamma+mu) is valid only for an R0/full-susceptibility interpretation (or S/N approximately 1).
beta_calibration.rt_source: approved rt_estimates.csv: independently estimated Rt_estimated only; OWID reproduction_rate is reference data and must not be substituted.
beta_calibration.evidence_justification: The Rt estimator is a renewal-ratio estimate from incidence and is therefore treated as an effective reproduction number for the mechanical replay. Substitution into the exact SEIRD Reff identity gives the stated beta relationship.
beta_calibration.applicability_limitations: This establishes internal mechanics, not a validated observation model or calibration: reported-case incidence, true susceptibility, vaccination, reinfection, and reporting are not identified by the approved OWID inputs. Missing Rt remains unavailable and beta is time-varying.

PRIMARY.scenario_basis: Early 2020 historical replay using Lauer, Cevik, and Verity evidence with explicit operational assumptions.

LOWER_DURATION_HIGH_RATE.scenario_basis: Omicron incubation and viable-virus evidence with lower Verity IFR bound; not a 2020 default.

UPPER_DURATION_LOW_RATE.scenario_basis: Pooled incubation sensitivity and Cevik day-9 boundary with upper Verity IFR bound; not universal.

pre_simulation_gate.beta_method: READY METHOD / NUMERIC BETA CONDITIONAL ON Rt
pre_simulation_gate.seird_execution: MECHANICAL UK REPLAY RUN; CALIBRATION NOT AUTHORIZED WITHOUT AN IDENTIFIABLE OBSERVATION MODEL

pre_simulation_requirements: All required numerical values are non-null, positive, and unit-consistent.
Every value has source, source_date, evidence_justification, and applicability_limitations.
The mortality definition explicitly distinguishes CFR, IFR, mortality probability, and mortality transition rate.
The selected beta relationship is mathematically consistent with the implemented SEIRD equations.
Observed OWID data remain separate from simulated compartments and simulated incidence/deaths.
Population N and compartment units are explicitly defined and conserved by the solver.
Chronological calibration and validation periods are specified before simulation.
